name: one-minute-pr
description: Pushes the branch and opens a pull request whose body a human reviewer can judge in one minute. The body uses fixed sections (Why, What changed, Scope, Tradeoffs, Blast Radius, Rollback, Verification) and only evidence the agent has seen. A bundled script fails the body on a wrong section order, a missing Scope or Rollback, an HTML comment, long dashes, curly quotes, or mid-sentence colons outside code. Works in Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity.
